exposure: Netherlands-developed decision tree for alloimmunization screening
Alternative model identifying high-risk women for screening based on maternal characteristics, obstetric history, and transfusion history
Alternative model exempting low-risk women from screening based on maternal characteristics, obstetric history, and transfusion history
cohort: Pregnant women in a Swedish cohort whose data was used to validate and compare antenatal red blood cell antibody screening models.
finding: The existing decision tree for maternal alloimmunization screening performed well in the Swedish population, identifying 89% of alloimmunized women with high predictive performance and screening 62% of the population.
